caseStudy.water-access-kampala.title: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa maĩ magĩaga kũgĩa na wĩtĩkĩri
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.summary: Gũthikĩrĩria ũrĩa andũ mararĩta ũhoro wa kũgĩa na maĩ Kampala-inĩ
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.imageAlt: Gĩcinga kĩa thoko kĩrĩ na andũ aingĩ hwaĩ-inĩ ya mũgoro
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.1: Kũrĩa andũ matũũraga Kampala-inĩ, kũgĩa na maĩ no kũgarũrũke o mũthenya kũrĩ mũthenya. Kũhĩtũka, maĩ matarĩ ma kũigana wega na mĩtugo mĩũru ya maĩ no ũgathĩĩnia mĩciĩ na mĩtũũrĩre ĩngĩngĩ kũringana na kũrĩa andũ matũũraga na mihũnga ĩrĩa ĩmatungatagĩra.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.2: Kũgerera Community Water Watch, WatchTower ĩrathondekwo nĩguo andũ mahote kũruta rũpoti ya ũrĩa marona na cĩũria ici na thiomi iria metĩkĩrĩkĩte mũno, na ũndũ ũcio ũgĩtũma rũpoti icio imwe ciume hamwe na cĩngĩ nĩguo ũhoro wa andũ ũmenyekane wega.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.3: Nĩgũkoragwo tũteteithĩkĩrĩra mĩthenya mĩingĩ tũtamenya hĩndĩ ĩrĩa maĩ makagooka rĩngĩ.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.4: Rũpoti ĩmwe ĩrionagia ũrĩa mũndũ ũmwe arĩonaga na arĩĩgĩĩte. No rĩrĩa rũpoti ta icio ciambĩrĩirie kuumĩra kũndũ kũingĩ na mahinda marĩa matiganĩte, nĩciambagĩrĩria kuonania ũhoro mũnene makĩria.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.5: Community Water Watch yathondekirwo nĩguo ũhoro ũcio ũrĩa andũ maragĩĩte ũcookanĩrĩrio hamwe na ũtuĩke mũhũthĩku na mũmenyekete wega.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.7: Data ya ndũire no ĩtuĩke ya ũhũthĩku mũno kũmenya ũrĩa mĩbango ya miako na mihũnga ĩrĩkũu ĩgĩĩkaga. No rĩrĩ, ti hĩndĩ ciothe ĩhota kũmenya ũrĩa kũgĩaga maĩ wega kũigĩĩte mĩciĩ-inĩ na kũrĩa andũ matũũraga.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.8: Andũ nĩmaragĩa ũhoro wa mĩthenya ĩrĩa matarĩ na maĩ, ũraihu ũrĩa maratwaraga magĩcaria maĩ mangĩ, ũgarũrũku wa ũthaka wa maĩ na ũrĩa kũhĩtũka kwa maĩ kũragathĩĩnia mũtũũrĩre wao wa o mũthenya.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.9: Rũpoti ya andũ nĩĩheaga rũgano rũngĩ rwa ũira, rũrĩa rũgwĩkĩra mũtĩrĩre harĩ ũrĩa andũ arĩa mehĩtĩkĩirie marona na marĩĩgĩĩte.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.10.a: Gĩcinga kĩa thoko kĩrĩ na andũ aingĩ hwaĩ-inĩ ya mũgoro
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.12: Community Water Watch nĩĩhũthĩrĩire WatchTower nĩguo rũpoti ĩgĩe ya mũhũthĩku na ĩhote kũrutwo na thiomi na kũndũ kũrĩa guothe.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.13: Kũruta rũpoti na thiomi iria metĩkĩrĩkĩte:
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.14: Andũ nĩmahoteete kũruta rũpoti na thiomi iria metĩkĩrĩkĩte mũno, na ũndũ ũcio ũkĩeheria bata wa kũgarũra ũhoro wao mbere ya kũũruta.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.15: Kũruta rũpoti na mũgambo kana maandĩko:
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.16: Rũpoti nĩciarutagwo na mũgambo kana na maandĩko, na ũndũ ũcio ũkĩhe andũ njĩra ngũrani cia kũgĩa ũhoro ũrĩa wekĩkaga.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.18: WatchTower nĩĩteithĩrĩirie kũnatha mũgambo, kũgarũra na kũcookanĩrĩria rũpoti, nĩguo ũhoro ũrĩa waretwo na thiomi ngũrani ũhote kũmenyeka hamwe.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.20: Rũpoti nĩciaroragwo kũringana na kũndũ, hĩndĩ na mũthemba wa ũhoro, na ũndũ ũcio ũgĩtũma mũtaratara wa rũpoti icio ciumanaga ihũthĩke na imenyekane wega.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.21: Wĩhoki wa mũbango wa kũgitĩra andũ:
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.22: Ũhoro wa mwene na kũndũ gũtũũgĩru no ũhũthĩrĩrwo na njĩra ya kũmũhinyĩrĩria kana kũũhitha harĩa kwagĩrĩire nĩguo kũgitĩre andũ arĩa mararuta rũpoti.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.24: O ũrĩa rũpoti cierĩgĩrĩire, ũhoro wa andũ ũmwe ũambĩrĩirie gũtuma ũhoro mũnene woneke.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.27: Rũpoti nĩcirutirwo kuuma kũndũ kũrĩa andũ matũũraga Kampala-inĩ guothe, na ciarĩ nyingĩ mũno harĩa haarĩ na ũhoro wa kũgĩa na maĩ, kũhĩtũka kwa maĩ na ũthaka wa maĩ.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.30: Kũthikĩrĩria no kũgĩe na ũhũthĩku rĩrĩa ũhoro ũrĩa andũ maragĩa ũhota gũtongoria ciĩko iria igũgĩĩka thuutha ũcio.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.31: Ũira ũrĩa wacookanĩrĩirio na Community Water Watch no ũteithĩrĩrie mĩario gatagatĩ ka andũ, rũrĩrĩ, kĩama na arũme arĩa mangĩ makĩruta wĩra wa kũmenyerera maĩ.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.32: Rũpoti icio no ihe ũtaũku mũnene wa kũmenya ũhoro makĩria, gũcambia, gũbanga mĩbango, gũcookanĩrĩria na kũrũmbũiya.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.34: Andũ arĩa marĩ hakuhĩ na ũhoro mũũru hĩndĩ ya kũgĩĩka nĩo metĩkĩrĩkĩte kũmenya maũndũ marĩa namba cia mũingĩ itahota kuonania.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.35: Rũpoti ya andũ nĩĩheaga njĩra ya kũgĩa na ũhoro ũcio o hĩndĩ ĩrĩa ũragĩĩka.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.36: Rĩrĩa andũ mahota kũruta rũpoti na thiomi ciao na rũpoti icio igacookanĩrĩrio, igalinkwo na igarorwo hamwe, mĩgambo ya o mũndũ no ĩgĩe na ũigĩĩru mũnene kũmenya ũrĩa ũhoro ũrĩkuhĩ kũmenyekana wega kũndũ kũrĩa ũrekĩkĩra.
